cases.name: Wanda Holden Cotton
cases.about: She was called “Mama C” and her obituary said: "She was a native and lifetime resident of Clay County and a graduate of Hayesville High School. Wanda earned an associate’s degree in Nursing and worked in healthcare for several years before she began having children. Wanda was a business woman and an active community leader. She established Parts City in 2012, and continued to operate the business throughout her life. Wanda served on both Clay County Chamber of Commerce and Clay County Board of Education, always trying to improve and give the kids of Clay County the best. Her presence, kindness and dedication to the community touched the lives of many and her contributions will not be forgotten. She attended both Moss Memorial Baptist Church and First Freewill Baptist Church. Wanda had a passion for antiquing. She spent many weekends picking through treasures or at one of her booth’s selling those treasures for others to enjoy. Her greatest joy came from her children and grandchildren, which she loved and cherished."
cases.narrative: On 6/10/2026, during a welfare check police found her dead on a bedroom floor, from a single gunshot wound.
